notes.title: Demo version now available
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267955/e6b72f781a6dc80937807a637946098a58be9abe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The demo version of One Turn Kill, a PvE card game where card drawing and deck control are the keys to victory, is now available! In this demo version, you can enjoy up to two rounds of gameplay. If you like this game, please leave your comments and impressions in the review section![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430320/One_Turn_Kill_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
